zh: 发明创造（发明、实用新型、外观设计的统称）
noteZh: 中国法特有的统称，美国法没有对应词。
noteEn: A Chinese umbrella term; no US equivalent.
exEn: For the purposes of this Law, "invention-creations" mean inventions, utility models and designs.
exZh: 本法所称的发明创造是指发明、实用新型和外观设计。

noteZh: “发明是新的技术方案”，中国审查的基本概念。
exEn: "Invention" means any new technical solution proposed for a product, a process or the improvement thereof.
exZh: 发明，是指对产品、方法或者其改进所提出的新的技术方案。

noteZh: 中美用词相同，但美国条文是“conditions for patentability; novelty”。
exEn: Novelty means that, the invention or utility model does not form part of the prior art; no entity or individual has filed a patent application for the identical invention or utility model with the patent administration department under the State Council before the filing date and the content of the application is disclosed in patent application documents published or patent documents announced after the filing date.
exZh: 新颖性，是指该发明或者实用新型不属于现有技术；也没有任何单位或者个人就同样的发明或者实用新型在申请日以前向国务院专利行政部门提出过申请，并记载在申请日以后公布的专利申请文件或者公告的专利文件中。

noteZh: 中国官方英译用 inventiveness；美国是 non-obviousness，欧洲是 inventive step。
exEn: Inventiveness means that, as compared with the prior art, the invention has prominent substantive features and represents an obvious progress, and that the utility model has substantive features and represents a progress.
exZh: 创造性，是指与现有技术相比，该发明具有突出的实质性特点和显著的进步，该实用新型具有实质性特点和进步。

noteZh: 美国叫 utility（来自 §101 的 useful）。
exEn: Practical use means that, the invention or utility model can be manufactured or used and can produce positive results.
exZh: 实用性，是指该发明或者实用新型能够制造或者使用，并且能够产生积极效果。

noteZh: 发明创造性的两个要素之一，另一个是“显著的进步”。
noteEn: One limb of inventiveness, with “obvious progress”.
exEn: Inventiveness means that, as compared with the prior art, the invention has prominent substantive features and represents an obvious progress, and that the utility model has substantive features and represents a progress.
exZh: 创造性，是指与现有技术相比，该发明具有突出的实质性特点和显著的进步，该实用新型具有实质性特点和进步。

noteZh: 中国定义：申请日以前国内外为公众所知的技术。
exEn: For the purpose of this Law, "the prior art" refers to any technology known to the public domestically and/or abroad before the filing date of patent application.
exZh: 本法所称现有技术，是指申请日以前在国内外为公众所知的技术。

noteZh: 美国用 effective filing date（有效申请日）判断新颖性。
noteEn: US novelty uses the effective filing date.
exEn: The term of patent right for inventions shall be twenty years, the term of patent right for utility models shall be ten years, and the term of patent right for designs shall be fifteen years, all commencing from the filing date.
exZh: 发明专利权的期限为二十年，实用新型专利权的期限为十年，外观设计专利权的期限为十五年，均自申请日起计算。

noteZh: 发明、实用新型十二个月，外观设计六个月。
exEn: Where, within twelve months from the date on which any applicant first filed in a foreign country a patent application for an invention or utility model, or within six months from the date on which any applicant first filed in a foreign country a patent application for a design, he or it files in China a patent application for the same subject matter, he or it may enjoy the right of priority in accordance with the agreements concluded between the foreign country and China, or in accordance with the international treaties to which both countries are parties, or on the basis of the principle of mutual recognition of the right of priority.
exZh: 申请人自发明或者实用新型在外国第一次提出专利申请之日起十二个月内，或者自外观设计在外国第一次提出专利申请之日起六个月内，又在中国就相同主题提出专利申请的，依照该外国同中国签订的协议或者共同参加的国际条约，或者依照相互承认优先权的原则，可以享有优先权。

noteZh: 发明专利申请须在申请日起三年内请求。
exEn: Within three years from the filing date, the patent administration department under the State Council may conduct a substantive examination of the application upon a request made by the applicant for a patent for invention at any time. If the applicant, without any justified reason, fails to request a substantive examination at the expiration of the time limit, the application shall be deemed to have been withdrawn.
exZh: 发明专利申请自申请日起三年内，国务院专利行政部门可以根据申请人随时提出的请求，对其申请进行实质审查；申请人无正当理由逾期不请求实质审查的，该申请即被视为撤回。

noteZh: 中国的无效宣告由国家知识产权局复审和无效审理部审理。
exEn: Beginning from the date of the announcement of the grant of a patent right by the patent administration department under the State Council, any entity or individual considers that the grant of the patent right is not in conformity with the relevant provisions of this Law, it or he may request the patent administration department under the State Council to declare the patent right invalid.
exZh: 自国务院专利行政部门公告授予专利权之日起，任何单位或者个人认为该专利权的授予不符合本法有关规定的，可以请求国务院专利行政部门宣告该专利权无效。

noteZh: 法律英语里 exploit 是中性的“实施、利用”，不是“剥削”。
noteEn: Neutral legal sense: to work or use a patent.
exEn: After the grant of the patent for an invention or an utility model, except where otherwise provided for in this Law, no entity or individual may, without the authorization of the patentee, exploit the patentee's patent, that is, for production or business purposes, manufacture, use, offer to sell, sell or import the patented product, or use the patented process, and use, offer to sell, sell or import the product directly obtained by the patented process.
exZh: 发明和实用新型专利权被授予后，除本法另有规定的以外，任何单位或者个人未经专利权人许可，都不得实施其专利，即不得为生产经营目的制造、使用、许诺销售、销售、进口其专利产品，或者使用其专利方法以及使用、许诺销售、销售、进口依照该专利方法直接获得的产品。

noteZh: 中美都把许诺销售列为侵权行为。
noteEn: An infringing act in both countries.
exEn: After the grant of the patent for an invention or an utility model, except where otherwise provided for in this Law, no entity or individual may, without the authorization of the patentee, exploit the patentee's patent, that is, for production or business purposes, manufacture, use, offer to sell, sell or import the patented product, or use the patented process, and use, offer to sell, sell or import the product directly obtained by the patented process.
exZh: 发明和实用新型专利权被授予后，除本法另有规定的以外，任何单位或者个人未经专利权人许可，都不得实施其专利，即不得为生产经营目的制造、使用、许诺销售、销售、进口其专利产品，或者使用其专利方法以及使用、许诺销售、销售、进口依照该专利方法直接获得的产品。

noteZh: 以权利要求的内容为准。
exEn: For the patent right of an invention or a utility model, the scope of protection shall be confined to the content of the claims. The description and the drawings attached may be used to explain the content of the claims.
exZh: 发明或者实用新型专利权的保护范围以其权利要求的内容为准，说明书及附图可以用于解释权利要求的内容。

noteZh: 新产品制造方法专利，被告负举证责任。
exEn: Where a patent infringement dispute involves a patent for an invention for a manufacturing process of a new product, the entity or individual manufacturing the identical product shall provide evidence to prove that the manufacturing process used in the manufacture of its or his product is different from the patented process.
exZh: 专利侵权纠纷涉及新产品制造方法的发明专利的，制造同样产品的单位或者个人应当提供其产品制造方法不同于专利方法的证明。

noteZh: 只针对实用新型和外观设计。
noteEn: Only for utility models and designs.
exEn: Where a patent infringement dispute involves a patent for a utility model or a design, the people's court or the department in charge of patent-related work may ask the patentee or any interested party to furnish a patent right evaluation report made by the patent administration department under the State Council after having conducted search, analysis and evaluation of the relevant utility model or design, and use it as evidence for hearing or dealing with the patent infringement dispute; the patentee or any interested party or the alleged infringer may also voluntarily furnish the patent right evaluation report.
exZh: 专利侵权纠纷涉及实用新型专利或者外观设计专利的，人民法院或者管理专利工作的部门可以要求专利权人或者利害关系人出具由国务院专利行政部门对相关实用新型或者外观设计进行检索、分析和评价后作出的专利权评价报告，作为审理、处理专利侵权纠纷的证据；专利权人、利害关系人或者被控侵权人也可以主动出具专利权评价报告。

noteZh: 情节严重的可判一到五倍惩罚性赔偿。
exEn: The amount of compensation for patent right infringement shall be determined on the basis of the actual losses suffered by the right holder as a result of the infringement or the profits earned by the infringer as a result of the infringement. Where it is difficult to determine the losses suffered by the right holder or the profits earned by the infringer, the amount shall be reasonably determined by reference to the multiple of the amount of the royalties for the patent license. For intentional infringement of a patent right, if the circumstances are serious, the amount of compensation may be determined at not less than one time and not more than five times the amount determined in accordance with the above-mentioned method.
exZh: 侵犯专利权的赔偿数额按照权利人因被侵权所受到的实际损失或者侵权人因侵权所获得的利益确定；权利人的损失或者侵权人获得的利益难以确定的，参照该专利许可使用费的倍数合理确定。对故意侵犯专利权，情节严重的，可以在按照上述方法确定数额的一倍以上五倍以下确定赔偿数额。

noteZh: 药品专利链接中，可以向国家知识产权局请求行政裁决。
noteEn: Available in Chinese drug patent linkage.
exEn: The applicant for marketing approval of the pharmaceutical product, the relevant patentee or the interested party may also petition the patent administration department under the State Council for an administrative adjudication on the disputes over the patent right associated with the drug applied for registration.
exZh: 药品上市许可申请人与有关专利权人或者利害关系人也可以就申请注册的药品相关的专利权纠纷，向国务院专利行政部门请求行政裁决。

noteZh: AIA 以后条文里大量使用这个词。
exEn: The term “claimed invention” means the subject matter defined by a claim in a patent or an application for a patent.
exZh: （j）“要求保护的发明”一词，指专利或者专利申请中某项权利要求所限定的主题。

noteZh: 相当于中国“申请日（有优先权的，指优先权日）”。
noteEn: Roughly China’s filing or priority date.
exEn: The term “effective filing date” for a claimed invention in a patent or application for patent means—
exZh: （1）专利或者专利申请中要求保护的发明的“有效申请日”，是指——

noteZh: IPR 只能用专利和印刷出版物作证据。
noteEn: The only evidence allowed in IPR besides patents.
exEn: the claimed invention was patented, described in a printed publication, or in public use, on sale, or otherwise available to the public before the effective filing date of the claimed invention; or
exZh: （1）要求保护的发明在其有效申请日之前已被授予专利、已在印刷出版物中描述、已公开使用、已销售或者以其他方式为公众所能获得；或者

noteZh: 名词是 obviousness（显而易见性）。
exEn: A patent for a claimed invention may not be obtained, notwithstanding that the claimed invention is not identically disclosed as set forth in section 102, if the differences between the claimed invention and the prior art are such that the claimed invention as a whole would have been obvious before the effective filing date of the claimed invention to a person having ordinary skill in the art to which the claimed invention pertains. Patentability shall not be negated by the manner in which the invention was made.
exZh: 要求保护的发明，即使未如第 102 条所述被完全相同地公开，但如果要求保护的发明与现有技术之间的区别使得该发明作为一个整体，在其有效申请日之前对于该发明所属领域的普通技术人员是显而易见的，则不得获得专利。可专利性不因作出发明的方式而被否定。

key: person having ordinary skill in the art
en: person having ordinary skill in the art
noteZh: 缩写 PHOSITA；中国叫“所属技术领域的技术人员”。
exEn: A patent for a claimed invention may not be obtained, notwithstanding that the claimed invention is not identically disclosed as set forth in section 102, if the differences between the claimed invention and the prior art are such that the claimed invention as a whole would have been obvious before the effective filing date of the claimed invention to a person having ordinary skill in the art to which the claimed invention pertains. Patentability shall not be negated by the manner in which the invention was made.
exZh: 要求保护的发明，即使未如第 102 条所述被完全相同地公开，但如果要求保护的发明与现有技术之间的区别使得该发明作为一个整体，在其有效申请日之前对于该发明所属领域的普通技术人员是显而易见的，则不得获得专利。可专利性不因作出发明的方式而被否定。

noteZh: 和可实施性是两项独立要求（Ariad 案）。
exEn: In General.— The specification shall contain a written description of the invention, and of the manner and process of making and using it, in such full, clear, concise, and exact terms as to enable any person skilled in the art to which it pertains, or with which it is most nearly connected, to make and use the same, and shall set forth the best mode contemplated by the inventor or joint inventor of carrying out the invention.
exZh: （a）总则。——说明书应当对发明以及制造和使用该发明的方式和过程作出书面描述，其用语应当完整、清楚、简明和确切，足以使该发明所属领域或者与之最密切相关领域的任何技术人员能够制造和使用该发明；并应当写明发明人或者共同发明人所设想的实施该发明的最佳方式。

noteZh: 名词 enablement；对应中国第二十六条第三款“能够实现”。
exEn: In General.— The specification shall contain a written description of the invention, and of the manner and process of making and using it, in such full, clear, concise, and exact terms as to enable any person skilled in the art to which it pertains, or with which it is most nearly connected, to make and use the same, and shall set forth the best mode contemplated by the inventor or joint inventor of carrying out the invention.
exZh: （a）总则。——说明书应当对发明以及制造和使用该发明的方式和过程作出书面描述，其用语应当完整、清楚、简明和确切，足以使该发明所属领域或者与之最密切相关领域的任何技术人员能够制造和使用该发明；并应当写明发明人或者共同发明人所设想的实施该发明的最佳方式。

noteZh: 未披露最佳方式已不能作为无效理由（§282(b)(3)(A)）。
exEn: In General.— The specification shall contain a written description of the invention, and of the manner and process of making and using it, in such full, clear, concise, and exact terms as to enable any person skilled in the art to which it pertains, or with which it is most nearly connected, to make and use the same, and shall set forth the best mode contemplated by the inventor or joint inventor of carrying out the invention.
exZh: （a）总则。——说明书应当对发明以及制造和使用该发明的方式和过程作出书面描述，其用语应当完整、清楚、简明和确切，足以使该发明所属领域或者与之最密切相关领域的任何技术人员能够制造和使用该发明；并应当写明发明人或者共同发明人所设想的实施该发明的最佳方式。

zh: 从属形式（从属权利要求）
noteZh: dependent claim 从属权利要求；independent claim 独立权利要求。
exEn: Reference in Dependent Forms.— Subject to subsection (e), a claim in dependent form shall contain a reference to a claim previously set forth and then specify a further limitation of the subject matter claimed. A claim in dependent form shall be construed to incorporate by reference all the limitations of the claim to which it refers.
exZh: （d）从属形式中的引用。——除第（e）款另有规定外，从属形式的权利要求应当引用在前的一项权利要求，然后对所要求保护的主题作进一步限定。从属形式的权利要求应当解释为通过引用包含了其所引用的权利要求的全部限定。

key: means or step for performing a specified function
en: means or step for performing a specified function
zh: 执行特定功能的手段或步骤
noteZh: 即“手段加功能”权利要求，保护范围限于说明书中的结构及其等同物。
exEn: Element in Claim for a Combination.— An element in a claim for a combination may be expressed as a means or step for performing a specified function without the recital of structure, material, or acts in support thereof, and such claim shall be construed to cover the corresponding structure, material, or acts described in the specification and equivalents thereof.
exZh: （f）组合权利要求中的要素。——组合权利要求中的要素，可以表述为执行特定功能的手段或者步骤，而不记载支持该功能的结构、材料或者动作；此类权利要求应当解释为涵盖说明书中描述的相应结构、材料或者动作及其等同物。

noteZh: 医药中常见：仿制药说明书指导医生按专利用途用药。
exEn: Whoever actively induces infringement of a patent shall be liable as an infringer.
exZh: （b）积极诱导他人侵犯专利的，应当作为侵权人承担责任。

noteZh: 前提是部件不是“常用物品或商品”。
exEn: Whoever offers to sell or sells within the United States or imports into the United States a component of a patented machine, manufacture, combination or composition, or a material or apparatus for use in practicing a patented process, constituting a material part of the invention, knowing the same to be especially made or especially adapted for use in an infringement of such patent, and not a staple article or commodity of commerce suitable for substantial noninfringing use, shall be liable as a contributory infringer.
exZh: （c）在美国境内许诺销售或者销售、或者向美国进口专利机器、制品、组合物或者物质组合物的部件，或者用于实施专利方法的材料或者装置，该部件、材料或者装置构成发明的实质部分，且行为人明知其是为侵犯该专利而专门制造或者专门改造的，并且不是适合实质性非侵权用途的常用物品或者商品的，应当作为帮助侵权人承担责任。

key: staple article or commodity of commerce
en: staple article or commodity of commerce
noteZh: 有实质性非侵权用途的通用物品，不构成帮助侵权。
exEn: Whoever offers to sell or sells within the United States or imports into the United States a component of a patented machine, manufacture, combination or composition, or a material or apparatus for use in practicing a patented process, constituting a material part of the invention, knowing the same to be especially made or especially adapted for use in an infringement of such patent, and not a staple article or commodity of commerce suitable for substantial noninfringing use, shall be liable as a contributory infringer.
exZh: （c）在美国境内许诺销售或者销售、或者向美国进口专利机器、制品、组合物或者物质组合物的部件，或者用于实施专利方法的材料或者装置，该部件、材料或者装置构成发明的实质部分，且行为人明知其是为侵犯该专利而专门制造或者专门改造的，并且不是适合实质性非侵权用途的常用物品或者商品的，应当作为帮助侵权人承担责任。

key: solely for uses reasonably related to
en: solely for uses reasonably related to
zh: 仅用于与……合理相关的用途
noteZh: Bolar 例外（安全港）的关键措辞。
noteEn: Key wording of the Bolar safe harbor.
exEn: It shall not be an act of infringement to make, use, offer to sell, or sell within the United States or import into the United States a patented invention (other than a new animal drug or veterinary biological product (as those terms are used in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and the Act of March 4, 1913) which is primarily manufactured using recombinant DNA, recombinant RNA, hybridoma technology, or other processes involving site specific genetic manipulation techniques) solely for uses reasonably related to the development and submission of information under a Federal law which regulates the manufacture, use, or sale of drugs or veterinary biological products.
exZh: （1）在美国境内制造、使用、许诺销售或者销售，或者向美国进口专利发明（主要利用重组 DNA、重组 RNA、杂交瘤技术或者其他涉及定点遗传操作技术的工艺制造的新兽药或者兽用生物制品除外——该等术语按《联邦食品、药品和化妆品法》及 1913 年 3 月 4 日法案中的含义使用），仅用于与依照规范药品或者兽用生物制品之制造、使用或者销售的联邦法律开发和提交信息合理相关的用途的，不构成侵权行为。

noteZh: 在法院主张无效须达到“清楚且有说服力的证据”标准。
noteEn: Clear and convincing evidence in court.
exEn: In General.— A patent shall be presumed valid. Each claim of a patent (whether in independent, dependent, or multiple dependent form) shall be presumed valid independently of the validity of other claims; dependent or multiple dependent claims shall be presumed valid even though dependent upon an invalid claim. The burden of establishing invalidity of a patent or any claim thereof shall rest on the party asserting such invalidity.
exZh: （a）总则。——专利应当推定为有效。专利的每一项权利要求（无论是独立、从属还是多项从属形式）均应当独立于其他权利要求的有效性而推定为有效；从属或者多项从属权利要求即使所从属的权利要求无效，也应当推定为有效。证明专利或者其任何权利要求无效的举证责任，由主张无效的一方承担。

noteZh: 依衡平法原则，由法院裁量。
exEn: The several courts having jurisdiction of cases under this title may grant injunctions in accordance with the principles of equity to prevent the violation of any right secured by patent, on such terms as the court deems reasonable.
exZh: 对本编所涉案件有管辖权的各法院，可以依照衡平法原则，按其认为合理的条件发出禁令，防止对专利所保障的任何权利的侵犯。

noteZh: 赔偿的最低标准。
exEn: Upon finding for the claimant the court shall award the claimant damages adequate to compensate for the infringement, but in no event less than a reasonable royalty for the use made of the invention by the infringer, together with interest and costs as fixed by the court. When the damages are not found by a jury, the court shall assess them. In either event the court may increase the damages up to three times the amount found or assessed. Increased damages under this paragraph shall not apply to provisional rights under section 154(d). The court may receive expert testimony as an aid to the determination of damages or of what royalty would be reasonable under the circumstances.
exZh: 认定请求人胜诉的，法院应当判给请求人足以弥补侵权所造成损失的赔偿，但无论如何不得低于侵权人使用该发明的合理许可费，并加上法院确定的利息和诉讼费用。损害赔偿未由陪审团认定的，由法院评定。在上述任一情形下，法院均可以将赔偿额提高至认定或者评定数额的三倍。本段规定的增加赔偿不适用于第 154 条（d）款规定的临时权利。法院可以采纳专家证言，以协助确定损害赔偿或者在当时情况下何为合理的许可费。

noteZh: 旧译“双方复审”；中国没有完全对应的程序。
exEn: In General.— Subject to the provisions of this chapter, a person who is not the owner of a patent may file with the Office a petition to institute an inter partes review of the patent. The Director shall establish, by regulation, fees to be paid by the person requesting the review, in such amounts as the Director determines to be reasonable, considering the aggregate costs of the review.
exZh: （a）总则。——除本章另有规定外，非专利所有人可以向专利商标局提交请求书，请求对该专利启动多方复审。局长应当以规章确定请求复审的人应缴纳的费用，费用数额由局长在考虑复审总成本后确定为合理的数额。

noteZh: 请求书必须写明全部实际利益方。
noteEn: Must be identified in the petition.
exEn: the petition identifies all real parties in interest;
exZh: （2）请求书写明了全部实际利益方；

noteZh: 专利权人在立案前提交。
noteEn: Filed by the patent owner before institution.
exEn: If an inter partes review petition is filed under section 311, the patent owner shall have the right to file a preliminary response to the petition, within a time period set by the Director, that sets forth reasons why no inter partes review should be instituted based upon the failure of the petition to meet any requirement of this chapter.
exZh: 依第 311 条提交多方复审请求书的，专利所有人有权在局长规定的期限内，对请求书提交初步答复，阐明因请求书不符合本章任何要求而不应启动多方复审的理由。

noteZh: IPR 的立案门槛；PGR 的门槛是“更有可能”（more likely than not）。
noteEn: IPR threshold; PGR uses “more likely than not”.
exEn: Threshold.— The Director may not authorize an inter partes review to be instituted unless the Director determines that the information presented in the petition filed under section 311 and any response filed under section 313 shows that there is a reasonable likelihood that the petitioner would prevail with respect to at least 1 of the claims challenged in the petition.
exZh: （a）门槛。——除非局长认定，依第 311 条提交的请求书和依第 313 条提交的任何答复所提供的信息表明，请求人至少就请求书中受到挑战的一项权利要求有合理可能胜诉，否则局长不得批准启动多方复审。

noteZh: 名词 institution，立案决定 institution decision。
exEn: Timing.— The Director shall determine whether to institute an inter partes review under this chapter pursuant to a petition filed under section 311 within 3 months after—
exZh: （b）时限。——局长应当在下列日期后 3 个月内，就是否根据依第 311 条提交的请求书启动本章规定的多方复审作出决定——

noteZh: 立案决定不能上诉。
exEn: No Appeal.— The determination by the Director whether to institute an inter partes review under this section shall be final and nonappealable.
exZh: （d）不得上诉。——局长依本条就是否启动多方复审作出的决定是终局的，不得上诉。

noteZh: IPR 的禁止反悔；专利侵权中还有“审查历史禁止反悔”（Festo 案）。
exEn: Proceedings before the office.— The petitioner in an inter partes review of a claim in a patent under this chapter that results in a final written decision under section 318(a), or the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, may not request or maintain a proceeding before the Office with respect to that claim on any ground that the petitioner raised or reasonably could have raised during that inter partes review.
exZh: （1）专利商标局程序。——依本章对专利的某项权利要求进行的多方复审作出了第 318 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定的，该多方复审的请求人，或者请求人的实际利益方或者利害关系人，不得以其在该多方复审中已经提出或者合理地本可以提出的任何理由，就该权利要求在专利商标局请求或者维持任何程序。

zh: 利害关系人（与请求人有密切关系的人）
noteZh: 常与 real party in interest 连用。
exEn: Proceedings before the office.— The petitioner in an inter partes review of a claim in a patent under this chapter that results in a final written decision under section 318(a), or the real party in interest or privy of the petitioner, may not request or maintain a proceeding before the Office with respect to that claim on any ground that the petitioner raised or reasonably could have raised during that inter partes review.
exZh: （1）专利商标局程序。——依本章对专利的某项权利要求进行的多方复审作出了第 318 条（a）款规定的最终书面决定的，该多方复审的请求人，或者请求人的实际利益方或者利害关系人，不得以其在该多方复审中已经提出或者合理地本可以提出的任何理由，就该权利要求在专利商标局请求或者维持任何程序。

noteZh: 合并不受一年期限限制。
noteEn: Not subject to the one-year bar.
exEn: Joinder.— If the Director institutes an inter partes review, the Director, in his or her discretion, may join as a party to that inter partes review any person who properly files a petition under section 311 that the Director, after receiving a preliminary response under section 313 or the expiration of the time for filing such a response, determines warrants the institution of an inter partes review under section 314.
exZh: （c）合并。——局长启动多方复审的，可以酌情将依第 311 条适当提交请求书、且局长在收到依第 313 条提交的初步答复或者提交答复的期限届满后认定应依第 314 条启动多方复审的任何人，合并为该多方复审的当事人。

noteZh: 比法院的“清楚且有说服力的证据”标准低。
exEn: Evidentiary Standards.— In an inter partes review instituted under this chapter, the petitioner shall have the burden of proving a proposition of unpatentability by a preponderance of the evidence.
exZh: （e）证明标准。——在依本章启动的多方复审中，请求人对不具备可专利性的主张负有以优势证据加以证明的责任。

noteZh: 通过修改动议提出。
noteEn: Proposed in a motion to amend.
exEn: setting forth standards and procedures for allowing the patent owner to move to amend the patent under subsection (d) to cancel a challenged claim or propose a reasonable number of substitute claims, and ensuring that any information submitted by the patent owner in support of any amendment entered under subsection (d) is made available to the public as part of the prosecution history of the patent;
exZh: （9）规定允许专利所有人依第（d）款申请修改专利、以删除受到挑战的权利要求或者提出合理数量的替代权利要求的标准和程序，并确保专利所有人为支持依第（d）款作出的修改而提交的任何信息，作为专利审查历史的一部分向公众公开；

noteZh: 对应中国专利法第三十三条“不得超出原说明书和权利要求书记载的范围”。
exEn: Scope of claims.— An amendment under this subsection may not enlarge the scope of the claims of the patent or introduce new matter.
exZh: （3）权利要求的范围。——依本款作出的修改，不得扩大专利权利要求的范围，也不得引入新的内容。

noteZh: 缩写 FWD，作出后可上诉到联邦巡回法院。
noteEn: Abbr. FWD; appealable to the CAFC.
exEn: Final Written Decision.— If an inter partes review is instituted and not dismissed under this chapter, the Patent Trial and Appeal Board shall issue a final written decision with respect to the patentability of any patent claim challenged by the petitioner and any new claim added under section 316(d).
exZh: （a）最终书面决定。——依本章启动且未被驳回的多方复审，专利审判和上诉委员会应当就请求人挑战的任何专利权利要求以及依第 316 条（d）款新增的任何权利要求的可专利性，作出最终书面决定。

noteZh: 授权后九个月内，可用任何无效理由。
exEn: In General.— Subject to the provisions of this chapter, a person who is not the owner of a patent may file with the Office a petition to institute a post-grant review of the patent.
